strings.records.gmo-correction.title: GMO: date correction at 00:20 verified; 12:00 is the attacker's announced time.
strings.records.gmo-correction.body: At 00:20 JST, report 7 corrected the date of the request for device investigation from 10/23 to 10/25. Report 7's content cutoff is 23:10 the previous day, and devices remain under analysis. The information disclosure and ransomware attack announced for 10/27 12:00 are threats from someone believed to be the attacker, not confirmed damage already inflicted.
strings.records.gmo-correction.action: Continue device inspection, backups, and account protection from report 6. Check official individual communications and do not respond to requests for authentication codes or money.
strings.records.railway-recovery.title: Railway: recovery channel opened; distinguish existing users from new registrations
strings.records.railway-recovery.body: Official status notices at 19:12 / 20:46 UTC say recovery continues and explicitly state this is not an additional security incident. The primary report's 20:41 UTC revision distinguishes restoration for existing users from suspended new registrations. Changes against the existing original are additions to Continuous Updates; do not recount the earlier estimate of about 10 ten-thousand workspaces as a new leak this time.
strings.records.railway-recovery.action: Continue revoking and reissuing sensitive environment variables, API keys, and other secrets stored before 10/21, and auditing GitHub and registries. Recovery does not guarantee the safety of old keys. Resumption of new registrations this week is planned.
strings.records.openhands-sdk.title: OpenHands SDK: unauthenticated command execution in publicly exposed sandbox agents.
strings.records.openhands-sdk.body: The CNA record for CVE-2026-112346 describes unauthenticated sandbox command execution with empty session_api_keys in SDK versions below 1.52.0. If the exposed port is reachable, root inside the sandbox and mounted workspaces and secrets are affected. The reviewed PR #5209 restricts DockerWorkspace host-side port exposure to 127.0.0.1 while retaining the 0.0.0.0 listener inside the container. This PR does not establish that the same fix applies to Apptainer, which the CNA also lists.
strings.records.openhands-sdk.action: Check fixes in software-agent-sdk 1.52.0 or later, recreate workspaces, and verify host port exposure and session key settings. Do not judge whether the SDK launcher fix is applied solely from the agent-server image tag. Separately investigate logs and revoke/reissue secrets from workspaces that were reachable.
strings.records.cloud-run-mcp.title: Cloud Run MCP: build bucket squatting
strings.records.cloud-run-mcp.body: CVE-2026-85297 affects Google Cloud Run MCP below 1.11.0. Google CNA describes source code access, code execution, and exfiltration through bucket squatting. This is separate from the previously included MCP Toolbox cloud-storage issue.
strings.records.cloud-run-mcp.action: Update Cloud Run MCP to 1.11.0 or later. Do not assess Toolbox and Cloud Run MCP as a single product; check the build path used and exposure of sensitive information.
strings.records.consul-leaf.title: Consul: authorization bypass for cached leaf certificates and private keys
strings.records.consul-leaf.body: CVE-2026-105765 affects Consul 1.17.0–2.0.4 with ACLs enabled. Cached service leaf responses from the agent HTTP API lack ACL token checks, allowing a reachable attacker to obtain already cached certificates and private keys under the applicable conditions. By default, the API listens only on loopback, limiting exposure to processes on the same host. This does not mean keys for every service can be obtained unconditionally.
strings.records.consul-leaf.action: Check Consul Community 2.1.0 and Enterprise 2.1.0 / 1.21.19 by release branch. Investigate agent API access restrictions and service identities and certificates that may have been exposed. Consider blocking the leaf endpoint only if Connect-native applications and consul-template do not depend on it.
strings.records.consul-http-acl.title: Consul: HTTP API DoS, mesh registration, and health-check authorization.
strings.records.consul-http-acl.body: CVE-2026-105626 exhausts memory through an unauthenticated HTTP API. 105608 allows Envoy escape-hatch configuration with service write permission and without mesh write. 115804 bypasses authorization, allowing an authenticated user to change other services' health checks on the same node. These have different prerequisites from the leaf private-key issue.
strings.records.consul-http-acl.action: Upgrade using official series-specific procedures to Community 2.1.0 or Enterprise 2.1.0 / 1.21.19. Inspect HTTP API exposure, service write privileges, and check registrations separately.
strings.records.consul-k8s.title: consul-k8s: component privileges from a ServiceAccount in another namespace
strings.records.consul-k8s.body: CVE-2026-110720 applies to configurations with global.acls.manageSystemACLs=true. A user who can create a ServiceAccount and obtain its token in another namespace, and can also reach the Consul API, can elevate privileges through ACL binding rules for components.
strings.records.consul-k8s.action: Check consul-k8s 2.1.0 / 1.8.18 by series. Verify Kubernetes RBAC, API reachability, and whether system ACL management is enabled.
strings.records.vllm-0320.title: vLLM: multiple conditions involving templates, shared memory, OCR, CORS, and Responses.
strings.records.vllm-0320.body: The CNA states that CVE-2026-115911–115918 are fixed in 0.32.0. They include resource exhaustion via request chat templates, shared memory identifiers, audio encoders, OCR/image processing, token ID boundaries, CORS, and Responses paths. Do not group issues requiring authenticated callers, specific models, or settings as blanket unauthenticated RCE.
strings.records.vllm-0320.action: Check vLLM 0.32.0, public API authentication, arbitrary templates, model sources, image/audio inputs, and CORS settings.
strings.records.onnx-models.title: ONNX: shape inference and low-bit arrays in untrusted models
strings.records.onnx-models.body: CVE-2026-115919–115922 affect versions below 1.22.0. These involve malformed model inputs concerning RNN/LSTM/GRU rank validation, ConvTranspose, Scan shape inference, and 2/4bit unpack array sizes. Passing the checker alone does not guarantee safe shape inference.
strings.records.onnx-models.action: Check ONNX 1.22.0 or later. Place external model validation in a restricted environment and set time and memory limits.
strings.records.netty-tcnative.title: Netty tcnative: native TLS buffers, tickets, and SNI
strings.records.netty-tcnative.body: CVE-2026-116539–116542 have different prerequisites involving native TLS BIO buffers, bytes-consumed reporting, SNI, session ticket rotation, and other features. The official GHSA for 116540 specifies builds with OpenSSL 3.0 or later, handshakes concurrent with hot rotation, affected versions from 2.0.81.Final, and a fix in 2.0.84.Final. Because this differs from the lower bound of 2.0.66.Final in the CNA record, this investigation does not establish the earliest affected version. Updating Java alone does not establish that the native library has been replaced.
strings.records.netty-tcnative.action: Verify the netty-tcnative 2.0.84.Final fix and the native artifact actually loaded. Check OpenSSL branches, ticket rotation, and SNI routing usage conditions separately.
strings.records.go-jose.title: Go JOSE: distinguish fix boundaries in 4.1.5 and 4.1.6.
strings.records.go-jose.body: CVE-2026-116585 concerns empty CBC-HMAC JWE ciphertext, and 116586 concerns panic/stack overflow from deeply nested JSON; both are fixed in 4.1.5. 116587 concerns validation load from malformed RSA JWKs, fixed in 4.1.6, with conditions involving Go 1.24 or later. Do not treat 4.1.5 alone as resolving everything.
strings.records.go-jose.action: Check go-jose 4.1.6 or later and rebuild embedded binaries. Impose input limits at entry points that parse untrusted JWE / JSON / JWK.
strings.records.compression-libraries.title: Autobahn / Rust zip / snappy-java / Go compress: separate decoder issues.
strings.records.compression-libraries.body: Autobahn CVE-2026-116579 is a DoS caused by checking the output limit of opt-in permessage-brotli after decompression, fixed in 26.10.1. Rust zip 115905 concerns central/local header filename mismatches, fixed in 9.0.5; the concurrently included 115906–115909 concern separate boundaries. snappy-java 116590 is fixed in 1.1.10.9, and the zstd panic in Go compress 116591 in 1.20.2. These are separate from Brotli2Shell CVE-2026-111497.
strings.records.compression-libraries.action: Inventory decoders actually used and untrusted-input paths, and apply each fix. A shared compression format does not establish remediation of separate CVEs.
strings.records.backstage-catalog.title: Backstage: canonicalization mismatch in catalog URL rules
strings.records.backstage-catalog.body: The 3.9.2 / 4.0.2 boundaries for CVE-2026-115923 are versions of the @backstage/plugin-catalog-backend package. A user with catalog.location.create permission can exploit differences between raw URL rules and URL reader normalization to have out-of-scope entities treated as trusted. A canonical URL matching fix was also confirmed in Backstage release v1.54.10; distinguish the main product version from the package version.
strings.records.backstage-catalog.action: Check @backstage/plugin-catalog-backend 3.9.2 / 4.0.2 or later for each release series. Do not assess only the displayed Backstage or custom portal version; inspect actual dependency packages, registration permissions, catalog.rules, and fetch URLs.
strings.records.kener-transmission.title: Kener / Transmission: management entry points and browser-mediated RPC
strings.records.kener-transmission.body: Kener CVE-2026-116747 affects 3.0.0 to before 4.1.10: DUMMY_SECRET fallback when KENER_SECRET_KEY is empty/unset allows an attacker who knows the administrator email to forge tokens. Transmission 116748 involves CORS exposing the RPC anti-CSRF token to other origins in 4.0.0 to before 4.1.3.
strings.records.kener-transmission.action: Update to Kener 4.1.10, configure a unique secret, and invalidate old sessions. Check the Transmission 4.1.3 fix and RPC authentication/access restrictions. Prioritize only if both products are deployed.
strings.records.retired-vysper.title: Apache Vysper: all versions affected; do not wait for a fixed version
strings.records.retired-vysper.body: CVE-2026-115721 involves unlimited allocation in XML parsing; 115748 involves missing authentication checks in XEP-0077. The project is retired and all versions are affected; Apache says no fixed release is planned. The latter requires an authenticated user to compromise another account.
strings.records.retired-vysper.action: If using Vysper, migrate to an alternative. Do not assign an unannounced fixed version; consider access and registration-feature restrictions until migration.
strings.records.malicious-packages.title: npm: separate 25 new malware entries from existing revisions
strings.records.malicious-packages.body: The 25 new entries include npm @greenlake/*, @ppa-web-components/*, @drone-js-ext/*, and ctf-agent 0.1.0. Publication was at 16:17–20:42 UTC. GHSA listing does not confirm compromise of organizations using them; do not generalize to other versions solely from package-name or scope matches.
strings.records.malicious-packages.action: Cross-check each GHSA's package and version against lockfiles, SBOMs, and install logs. If executed, isolate the environment and revoke/reissue secrets held there from a separate safe device. Do not consider uninstalling alone sufficient.
strings.records.ghsa-existing.title: 31 GHSA reviewed revisions: Airflow and CA bundles were previously published
strings.records.ghsa-existing.body: There are 0 reviewed advisories in the publication window and 31 in the revision window. These include existing advisories for Airflow JWT logout / Hive / Edge3 / Google / Sqoop / Mongo providers, NASA AIT-Core, AgentScope, Aim, AutoGPT, certifi emSign CA, ImageSharp, and others. Some were published in 2022–2025; do not turn the 31 into new zero-days this morning.
strings.records.ghsa-existing.action: Check installed packages against each GHSA's current ranges and fixes. Do not confuse certifi CA distrust with other Tailworm or Brotli fixes.
strings.records.apple-oct26.title: Apple: check OS/Safari security releases dated 10/26
strings.records.apple-oct26.body: Apple primary sources confirm the 10/26 releases of iOS/iPadOS 27.2 and 26.7.2, and macOS Golden Gate 27.2. Of 532 new NVD records in this window, 324 are Apple CNA records and also reference fixes in earlier releases. This does not mean all 324 were newly shipped or confirmed exploited in this window.
strings.records.apple-oct26.action: Match each device's supported series against Software Update and the official security releases list, and update the OS and Safari. Do not universally require series 27 for older-series devices; check supported models.
strings.records.apple-oct26.time: 10 / 26 release (official date), NVD inclusion is in the fixed window.
strings.records.connectwise-continuity.title: ConnectWise: preparations continue; keep connections disabled until individual instructions.
strings.records.connectwise-continuity.body: The retrieved text still shows a last update of 10/26 14:00 UTC. It describes preparations for phased onboarding and notification when restoration can begin. Do not rewrite the 10/26 target as a report of achievement; refer to the same primary text as previously.
strings.records.connectwise-continuity.action: Keep affected connections disabled until individual procedures are provided; separately investigate M365 app consent, forwarding rules, sign-ins, and devices.
strings.records.connectwise-continuity.time: Previous 23:00 JST update (Main text continues with this acquisition)
strings.records.php-panos.title: PHP / PAN-OS / IceWarp: continue checking series-specific hotfixes and deployment
strings.records.php-panos.body: The latest PAN JSON timeline entry is 10/26 05:45 UTC; release information for the 4 hotfixes in the 11.1 branch is unchanged. The official IceWarp API text is also unchanged, revised at 15:30 UTC. Configuration changes in old IceWarp versions are partial mitigation, not complete remediation.
strings.records.php-panos.action: Restrict exposed management interfaces and check PHP fixes, product hotfixes, restarts of all workers, and the actual bundled copies. Do not convert PAN ETAs into shipped releases or apply IceWarp's memory_limit=-1 and similar settings unconditionally to other environments.
strings.records.tailscale-continued.title: Tailscale / eMudhra: latest stable 1.104.2; Tailworm fixed version unconfirmed
strings.records.tailscale-continued.body: The latest stable official release is 1.104.2 dated 10/21. Do not reinterpret the version addressing the eMudhra intermediate CA as the minimum fixed Tailworm version. Source merges or environment variables alone do not establish a distributed fix.
strings.records.tailscale-continued.action: Distinguish eMudhra remediation from the reachability conditions for SSH forwarding / Serve / Funnel and similar features, and track official bulletins and releases. Secure an alternative management path before disabling unnecessary forwarding.
strings.records.genesys-scope.title: Genesys: distinguish internal LMS/CRM from customer platforms
strings.records.genesys-scope.body: The affected party describes an internal business system incident identified on 10/16. It confirms access to/acquisition of business contact and account information in LMS/CRM, while denying compromise of Cloud / Engage / Engage Cloud or call recordings in customer platforms. Investigation continues. Do not count this as a new intrusion in the current window.
strings.records.genesys-scope.action: Watch for suspicious contacts claiming to be Genesys and citing business information; verify through official channels. Do not generalize an internal CRM leak into compromise of all customer contact centers.
strings.records.genesys-scope.time: 10 / 16 Existing cases and scope to be understood and supplemented
strings.records.frontline-notification.title: Reference: Frontline Education notice of August (month 8) incident
strings.records.frontline-notification.body: The party's 10/26 disclosure describes the start of individual notifications about unauthorized activity on 8/14–15 in Frontline Central / School Health Management. Affected information varies by individual, including SSN, date of birth, government ID, and Medicaid / Student ID. This is not a new 10/26 intrusion; because the publication time has only a date, it is separated from confirmed changes within the fixed window.
strings.records.frontline-notification.action: Check your affected information and relevant credit monitoring guidance through the affected school district and individual notifications. Do not generalize that the same information leaked for every child.

records.action: If using Vysper, migrate to an alternative. Do not assign an unannounced fixed version; consider access and registration-feature restrictions until migration.

records.title: npm: separate 25 new malware entries from existing revisions
records.body: The 25 new entries include npm @greenlake/*, @ppa-web-components/*, @drone-js-ext/*, and ctf-agent 0.1.0. Publication was at 16:17–20:42 UTC. GHSA listing does not confirm compromise of organizations using them; do not generalize to other versions solely from package-name or scope matches.
records.action: Cross-check each GHSA's package and version against lockfiles, SBOMs, and install logs. If executed, isolate the environment and revoke/reissue secrets held there from a separate safe device. Do not consider uninstalling alone sufficient.

records.title: 31 GHSA reviewed revisions: Airflow and CA bundles were previously published
records.body: There are 0 reviewed advisories in the publication window and 31 in the revision window. These include existing advisories for Airflow JWT logout / Hive / Edge3 / Google / Sqoop / Mongo providers, NASA AIT-Core, AgentScope, Aim, AutoGPT, certifi emSign CA, ImageSharp, and others. Some were published in 2022–2025; do not turn the 31 into new zero-days this morning.
records.action: Check installed packages against each GHSA's current ranges and fixes. Do not confuse certifi CA distrust with other Tailworm or Brotli fixes.

records.title: Apple: check OS/Safari security releases dated 10/26
records.body: Apple primary sources confirm the 10/26 releases of iOS/iPadOS 27.2 and 26.7.2, and macOS Golden Gate 27.2. Of 532 new NVD records in this window, 324 are Apple CNA records and also reference fixes in earlier releases. This does not mean all 324 were newly shipped or confirmed exploited in this window.
records.action: Match each device's supported series against Software Update and the official security releases list, and update the OS and Safari. Do not universally require series 27 for older-series devices; check supported models.
records.time: 10 / 26 release (official date), NVD inclusion is in the fixed window.

records.title: ConnectWise: preparations continue; keep connections disabled until individual instructions.
records.body: The retrieved text still shows a last update of 10/26 14:00 UTC. It describes preparations for phased onboarding and notification when restoration can begin. Do not rewrite the 10/26 target as a report of achievement; refer to the same primary text as previously.
records.action: Keep affected connections disabled until individual procedures are provided; separately investigate M365 app consent, forwarding rules, sign-ins, and devices.
records.time: Previous 23:00 JST update (Main text continues with this acquisition)

records.title: PHP / PAN-OS / IceWarp: continue checking series-specific hotfixes and deployment
records.body: The latest PAN JSON timeline entry is 10/26 05:45 UTC; release information for the 4 hotfixes in the 11.1 branch is unchanged. The official IceWarp API text is also unchanged, revised at 15:30 UTC. Configuration changes in old IceWarp versions are partial mitigation, not complete remediation.
records.action: Restrict exposed management interfaces and check PHP fixes, product hotfixes, restarts of all workers, and the actual bundled copies. Do not convert PAN ETAs into shipped releases or apply IceWarp's memory_limit=-1 and similar settings unconditionally to other environments.

records.title: Tailscale / eMudhra: latest stable 1.104.2; Tailworm fixed version unconfirmed
records.body: The latest stable official release is 1.104.2 dated 10/21. Do not reinterpret the version addressing the eMudhra intermediate CA as the minimum fixed Tailworm version. Source merges or environment variables alone do not establish a distributed fix.
records.action: Distinguish eMudhra remediation from the reachability conditions for SSH forwarding / Serve / Funnel and similar features, and track official bulletins and releases. Secure an alternative management path before disabling unnecessary forwarding.

records.title: Genesys: distinguish internal LMS/CRM from customer platforms
records.body: The affected party describes an internal business system incident identified on 10/16. It confirms access to/acquisition of business contact and account information in LMS/CRM, while denying compromise of Cloud / Engage / Engage Cloud or call recordings in customer platforms. Investigation continues. Do not count this as a new intrusion in the current window.
records.action: Watch for suspicious contacts claiming to be Genesys and citing business information; verify through official channels. Do not generalize an internal CRM leak into compromise of all customer contact centers.
records.time: 10 / 16 Existing cases and scope to be understood and supplemented

records.title: Reference: Frontline Education notice of August (month 8) incident
records.body: The party's 10/26 disclosure describes the start of individual notifications about unauthorized activity on 8/14–15 in Frontline Central / School Health Management. Affected information varies by individual, including SSN, date of birth, government ID, and Medicaid / Student ID. This is not a new 10/26 intrusion; because the publication time has only a date, it is separated from confirmed changes within the fixed window.
records.action: Check your affected information and relevant credit monitoring guidance through the affected school district and individual notifications. Do not generalize that the same information leaked for every child.

report.title: 10 07:47 Morning check of incidents, vulnerabilities, and 27
report.headline: Keys, public APIs, and device updates, starting with what you have installed.
report.intro: Organized GMO's correction, Railway recovery updates, Apple's security releases, and remediation for Consul, OpenHands, MCP, and AI inference infrastructure using primary sources. Database inclusion is distinguished from new compromise.

quick.text: GMO corrected the request date at 00:20. 12:00 is the attacker's announced time. Railway issued a recovery notice; continue revoking and reissuing old secrets.

quick.text: Inventory public sandbox authentication, Cloud Run MCP buckets, and vLLM/ONNX input paths. Check reachability conditions as well as versions.

quick.text: Check supported Apple series updates, native TLS, Go JOSE, compression decoders, and malicious packages. Do not count the 324 Apple CNA additions as new victims.
